chapter: Day job, band photographs and Chicago
title: Another WPA band photo with about a hundred musicians
summary: The interviewer notes the large WPA band picture and Sal praises its quality.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: What is this? The WPA band again in this? Yeah, the Tight Hole. Same band. Yeah. Looks like you've got about a hundred musicians, eh? Yeah. I don't know how many there are. I couldn't count. I said, man.
Well, we had a good band, boy. We were drumming in that, man. Boy, Casper, Louis Voyages, the best, man. I mean, militant ships, you know? The best.
